easy: A cute, friendly word for a dog.

ex.en: The little doggy wagged its tail at me.
ex.ko: 작은 멍멍이가 나를 보고 꼬리를 흔들었다.

easy: A share of money, food, or clothes given out to people in need.

ex.en: The church gave out a dole of bread to hungry families.
ex.ko: 교회는 배고픈 가족들에게 빵을 나누어 주었다.

easy: Dull grayish brown in color.

ex.en: The dun prairie looked dry and dusty in the summer.
ex.ko: 여름의 회갈색 초원은 메마르고 먼지투성이로 보였다.

easy: Growing faster and faster, often by doubling again and again.

ex.en: The number of rabbits had exponential growth, doubling every month.
ex.ko: 토끼 수는 매달 두 배씩 기하급수적으로 늘었다.

easy: In a way that leads to failure or death.

ex.en: The plan was fatally flawed because no one brought the map.
ex.ko: 아무도 지도를 가져오지 않아서 그 계획은 치명적인 결함이 있었다.

easy: Very much, in a way that is clearly wrong.

ex.en: The fisherman grossly exaggerated the size of the fish he caught.
ex.ko: 그 낚시꾼은 자기가 잡은 물고기 크기를 터무니없이 부풀렸다.

easy: Having to do with harmony, the different notes that sound good played together.

ex.en: The choir practiced the harmonic parts of the song.
ex.ko: 합창단은 노래의 화음 부분을 연습했다.

easy: One of the bright lights on the front of a car.

ex.en: The car's headlights lit up the dark road.
ex.ko: 자동차 전조등이 어두운 길을 밝혔다.

easy: Looking at the whole thing and how all its parts work together.

ex.en: Our school takes a holistic approach, caring for kids' bodies, minds, and feelings.
ex.ko: 우리 학교는 아이들의 몸과 마음과 감정을 함께 돌보는 전체적인 방식을 쓴다.

easy: Having to do with hormones, chemicals in the body that control growth and feelings.

ex.en: Teenagers go through many hormonal changes.
ex.ko: 십 대들은 많은 호르몬 변화를 겪는다.

easy: Getting into someone's private space or business when you are not wanted.

ex.en: My little sister's intrusive questions bothered my friends.
ex.ko: 여동생이 꼬치꼬치 캐묻는 바람에 내 친구들이 귀찮아했다.

easy: Very dangerous to health and likely to spread, like some tumors.

ex.en: The doctor was glad the lump was not malignant.
ex.ko: 의사는 그 혹이 악성이 아니어서 다행이라고 했다.

easy: A person who thinks and acts in their own way, not like everyone else.

ex.en: The artist was a maverick who painted with ketchup and mustard.
ex.ko: 그 화가는 케첩과 머스터드로 그림을 그리는 독특한 사람이었다.

easy: Thinking or acting in your own way, not like everyone else.

ex.en: Her maverick ideas made our science project stand out.
ex.ko: 그녀의 독특한 아이디어 덕분에 우리 과학 프로젝트가 돋보였다.

easy: A germ, like a virus or bacteria, that makes you sick.

ex.en: Washing your hands helps stop pathogens from spreading.
ex.ko: 손을 씻으면 병원체가 퍼지는 것을 막을 수 있다.

easy: A guess about how something, like an illness, will turn out.

ex.en: The doctor's prognosis was good: my leg would heal in six weeks.
ex.ko: 의사 선생님의 예측은 좋았다. 내 다리가 6주면 나을 거라고 하셨다.

easy: Easy to understand and connect with because it is like your own life.

ex.en: The main character is relatable because she is nervous on the first day of school too.
ex.ko: 주인공도 개학 첫날 긴장해서 공감이 간다.

easy: Only a very short time before something else happened.

ex.en: We had scarcely sat down when the bell rang.
ex.ko: 우리가 자리에 앉자마자 종이 울렸다.

easy: Having to do with a main subject or topic.

ex.en: Our teacher made thematic units, like a whole week about oceans.
ex.ko: 선생님은 일주일 내내 바다를 배우는 것처럼 주제별 단원을 만드셨다.

easy: Strange in a spooky way, as if something magic were happening.

ex.en: There was an uncanny silence in the old house.
ex.ko: 오래된 집 안은 섬뜩할 만큼 조용했다.

easy: Not fair or not allowed by law.

ex.en: The prince was the wrongful king because he stole the crown.
ex.ko: 그 왕자는 왕관을 훔쳤기 때문에 부당한 왕이었다.

easy: A sailing ship with two tall masts and square sails.

ex.en: The pirates sailed a fast brig across the sea.
ex.ko: 해적들은 빠른 쌍돛대 범선을 타고 바다를 건넜다.

easy: Making expensive, fancy clothes by hand for very rich or famous people.

ex.en: The movie star wore couture from Paris to the awards show.
ex.ko: 그 영화배우는 시상식에 파리의 고급 맞춤 의상을 입고 왔다.

easy: Belonging to this world, not to heaven.

ex.en: In the story, the angel had never tasted earthly food like pizza.
ex.ko: 이야기 속 천사는 피자 같은 이 세상의 음식을 먹어 본 적이 없었다.

easy: The special spirit and beliefs of a group, culture, or time.

ex.en: Our school's ethos is kindness and respect.
ex.ko: 우리 학교의 정신은 친절과 존중이다.

easy: Something you have to give up or do as a penalty.

ex.en: In the party game, the loser had to pay a forfeit and sing a song.
ex.ko: 파티 게임에서 진 사람은 벌칙으로 노래를 불러야 했다.

easy: To lose something because you broke a rule or made a mistake.

ex.en: Our team forfeited the game because only five players showed up.
ex.ko: 선수가 다섯 명만 와서 우리 팀은 몰수패를 당했다.

easy: To start something officially, often with a ceremony.

ex.en: The mayor inaugurated the new library by cutting a ribbon.
ex.ko: 시장은 리본을 잘라 새 도서관의 문을 열었다.

easy: One of the bumpy joints on your fingers that stick out when you make a fist.

ex.en: I scraped my knuckles on the brick wall.
ex.ko: 나는 벽돌담에 손가락 마디를 긁혔다.

easy: Wild and too excited, without calm thinking.

ex.en: The puppy ran around the yard in a manic burst of energy.
ex.ko: 강아지는 기운이 넘쳐 미친 듯이 마당을 뛰어다녔다.

easy: Many and of different kinds.

ex.en: There are manifold reasons to read every day.
ex.ko: 매일 책을 읽어야 할 이유는 여러 가지가 있다.

easy: The old part of a city in North Africa, with narrow streets and markets.

ex.en: We got lost in the narrow streets of the medina in Morocco.
ex.ko: 우리는 모로코 메디나의 좁은 골목에서 길을 잃었다.

easy: A tiny bit of light energy.

ex.en: Light is made of tiny bits of energy called photons.
ex.ko: 빛은 광자라는 아주 작은 에너지 알갱이로 이루어져 있다.

easy: An informal word for a British pound, the money used in the UK.

ex.en: The comic book cost five quid in London.
ex.ko: 런던에서 그 만화책은 5파운드였다.

easy: A tree with clusters of bright orange-red berries.

ex.en: Birds love to eat the red berries of the rowan tree.
ex.ko: 새들은 마가목의 빨간 열매를 아주 좋아한다.

easy: A meeting of church leaders to talk about church matters.

ex.en: The church leaders met at a synod to make new rules.
ex.ko: 교회 지도자들이 교회 회의에 모여 새 규칙을 정했다.

easy: A unit for measuring the push of electricity.

ex.en: A AA battery has 1.5 volts.
ex.ko: AA 건전지는 1.5볼트이다.

easy: To have and use power or control.

ex.en: The team captain wields a lot of power over who plays first.
ex.ko: 팀 주장은 누가 먼저 뛸지 정하는 데 큰 힘을 가지고 있다.

easy: Something in the body that is not normal or not formed the usual way.

ex.en: The X-ray showed no abnormality in my bones.
ex.ko: 엑스레이에서 내 뼈에 아무 이상도 보이지 않았다.

easy: Taking a tiny piece of the body to test it for a disease.

ex.en: The doctor did a biopsy to make sure the spot was harmless.
ex.ko: 의사는 그 점이 해롭지 않은지 확인하려고 조직 검사를 했다.

easy: A soldier trained to make quick, surprise attacks.

ex.en: The commandos climbed the cliff in the dark.
ex.ko: 특공대원들이 어둠 속에서 절벽을 올랐다.

easy: A government order that stops trade with another country.

ex.en: The country put an embargo on trade with its enemy.
ex.ko: 그 나라는 적국과의 무역을 금지했다.

easy: To change information into a code, like the numbers a computer uses.

ex.en: The computer encodes pictures as long lists of numbers.
ex.ko: 컴퓨터는 그림을 긴 숫자 목록으로 바꾸어 저장한다.

easy: To fix something firmly so it is hard to change.

ex.en: Practicing every day entrenched the habit of reading before bed.
ex.ko: 매일 연습하다 보니 자기 전에 책 읽는 습관이 확실히 자리 잡았다.

easy: Having ideas that go much too far and refusing to give in at all.

ex.en: Extremism can make people stop listening to each other.
ex.ko: 극단주의는 사람들이 서로의 말을 듣지 않게 만들 수 있다.

easy: To finish the last details of something and make it final.

ex.en: We finalized our plans for the class trip.
ex.ko: 우리는 반 소풍 계획을 확정했다.

easy: A way of getting oil and gas by cracking deep rocks with water pushed in very hard.

ex.en: Fracking breaks deep rocks with water to get gas out.
ex.ko: 수압 파쇄법은 물로 깊은 곳의 바위를 깨서 가스를 뽑아낸다.

easy: A soldier who fires big guns or cannons.

ex.en: The gunner fired the old cannon at the history show.
ex.ko: 역사 공연에서 포병이 오래된 대포를 쏘았다.

easy: A fight by a group trying to take over the government by force.

ex.en: The army tried to stop the insurgency in the mountains.
ex.ko: 군대는 산악 지대의 반란을 막으려 했다.

easy: Something done that breaks the rules.

ex.en: The teacher found an irregularity in the vote: someone voted twice.
ex.ko: 선생님은 투표에서 부정을 찾아내셨다. 누군가 두 번 투표했던 것이다.

easy: Things kept because they remind you of a special person or event.

ex.en: Dad collects baseball memorabilia like signed balls and old tickets.
ex.ko: 아빠는 사인 공과 오래된 표 같은 야구 기념품을 모으신다.

easy: A poem that praises someone or something, often in a grand way.

ex.en: The poet wrote an ode to the ocean.
ex.ko: 그 시인은 바다를 기리는 시를 썼다.

easy: A soft cloth with a colorful pattern of curvy, teardrop shapes.

ex.en: Grandma's scarf is made of soft paisley.
ex.ko: 할머니 스카프는 부드러운 페이즐리 천으로 만들어졌다.

easy: Loose pants tied at the waist with a string, worn in some Asian countries.

ex.en: In India, some men wear a loose pajama under a long shirt.
ex.ko: 인도에서는 어떤 남자들이 긴 셔츠 아래에 헐렁한 파자마 바지를 입는다.

easy: A prince or king in India.

ex.en: The raja lived in a palace with white elephants.
ex.ko: 라자는 흰 코끼리들이 있는 궁전에 살았다.

easy: Part of the money you paid that is given back to you.

ex.en: Mom mailed a form to get a ten-dollar rebate on the blender.
ex.ko: 엄마는 믹서기 값 중 10달러를 돌려받으려고 서류를 우편으로 보내셨다.

easy: Something in some people's blood that doctors check before giving them someone else's blood.

ex.en: Doctors check your Rh factor before giving you blood.
ex.ko: 의사들은 수혈하기 전에 Rh 인자를 확인한다.

easy: A giant bird in old Arabian stories, big and strong enough to carry an elephant.

ex.en: In the tale, Sinbad was carried away by a giant roc.
ex.ko: 그 이야기에서 신드바드는 거대한 로크에게 실려 갔다.

easy: The study of the colors in light to find out what things are made of.

ex.en: Using spectroscopy, scientists learn what stars are made of.
ex.ko: 과학자들은 분광학으로 별이 무엇으로 이루어졌는지 알아낸다.

easy: A powerful yellow explosive used for blasting rock.

ex.en: Workers used TNT to blast a tunnel through the mountain.
ex.ko: 인부들은 TNT로 산을 폭파해 터널을 뚫었다.

easy: A powerful computer operating system.

ex.en: Many big computers run on UNIX.
ex.ko: 많은 대형 컴퓨터가 유닉스로 작동한다.

easy: In the upper part of a city, usually away from the busy business area.

ex.en: We visited my aunt's uptown apartment.
ex.ko: 우리는 업타운에 있는 이모의 아파트에 갔다.

easy: The part of a city where people live, away from the busy downtown.

ex.en: Uptown is much quieter than downtown.
ex.ko: 업타운은 시내 중심가보다 훨씬 조용하다.

easy: To or in the upper part of a town.

ex.en: We walked uptown to find a quiet place for dinner.
ex.ko: 우리는 조용히 저녁 먹을 곳을 찾아 업타운으로 걸어갔다.

easy: Having to do with pee and the body parts that make it.

ex.en: Drinking water keeps your urinary system healthy.
ex.ko: 물을 마시면 비뇨기가 건강해진다.

easy: A person who tries to punish criminals on their own, without the police.

ex.en: In the comic, the hero is a vigilante who fights crime at night.
ex.ko: 그 만화에서 주인공은 밤에 범죄와 싸우는 자경단원이다.

easy: A group of countries in Southeast Asia that work together.

ex.en: Vietnam and Thailand are both members of ASEAN.
ex.ko: 베트남과 태국은 둘 다 아세안 회원국이다.

easy: A word people long ago used for someone from outside their own culture whom they thought was wild.

ex.en: The Romans called many people outside their empire barbarians.
ex.ko: 로마인들은 제국 밖의 많은 사람들을 야만인이라고 불렀다.

easy: Wild and rough, without manners or civilization.

ex.en: The castle walls kept out the barbarian invaders.
ex.ko: 성벽이 야만적인 침입자들을 막아 주었다.

easy: Words that show disrespect for God or holy things.

ex.en: In some countries, blasphemy is against the law.
ex.ko: 어떤 나라에서는 신성 모독이 법으로 금지되어 있다.

easy: An army officer who ranks just below a major general.

ex.en: The brigadier gave orders to the soldiers.
ex.ko: 준장이 군인들에게 명령을 내렸다.

easy: An Irish girl.

ex.en: The colleen danced a lively jig at the festival.
ex.ko: 그 아일랜드 소녀는 축제에서 신나는 지그 춤을 추었다.

easy: A hard, dark rock powder used to smooth and polish things.

ex.en: An emery board is used to file fingernails.
ex.ko: 손톱 다듬는 줄은 금강사로 만든다.

easy: The study of how diseases spread and how to stop them.

ex.en: Scientists in epidemiology track how the flu spreads each winter.
ex.ko: 역학 학자들은 겨울마다 독감이 어떻게 퍼지는지 추적한다.

easy: The secret police and spy agency of the old Soviet Union.

ex.en: In the spy movie, the hero escaped from KGB agents.
ex.ko: 첩보 영화에서 주인공은 KGB 요원들에게서 탈출했다.

easy: A British word for a toilet.

ex.en: "I need to go to the loo," said my British friend.
ex.ko: "화장실 가야겠어." 하고 영국 친구가 말했다.

easy: Getting into other people's business when it is not wanted.

ex.en: Our meddling neighbor always tells us how to mow our lawn.
ex.ko: 참견 많은 이웃은 늘 우리에게 잔디 깎는 법을 일러 준다.

easy: Changing something secretly or in a wrong way.

ex.en: Someone's meddling with the clock made us late for school.
ex.ko: 누가 몰래 시계를 건드려서 우리는 학교에 늦었다.

easy: A person trained to give emergency medical help, often in an ambulance.

ex.en: The paramedics helped the man who fell off his bike.
ex.ko: 구급대원들이 자전거에서 떨어진 남자를 도왔다.

easy: All the priests of a religion as a group.

ex.en: My uncle decided to join the priesthood.
ex.ko: 삼촌은 성직자가 되기로 결심했다.

easy: The family of kings and queens who ruled England from 1485 to 1603.

ex.en: Queen Elizabeth I was the last Tudor ruler.
ex.ko: 엘리자베스 1세는 튜더 왕가의 마지막 통치자였다.

easy: Built in an old English style with white walls and dark wooden beams.

ex.en: The Tudor house had white walls with dark wooden beams.
ex.ko: 튜더 양식의 그 집은 하얀 벽에 짙은 나무 기둥이 있었다.

easy: A ship built to fight in a war.

ex.en: The old warship is now a museum we can visit.
ex.ko: 그 오래된 군함은 이제 우리가 가 볼 수 있는 박물관이 되었다.

easy: An official paper from a court that orders someone to do something.

ex.en: The court sent a writ ordering him to come in.
ex.ko: 법원은 그에게 출석하라는 영장을 보냈다.

easy: To make someone stop feeling friendly toward you.

ex.en: His bossy ways alienated his friends.
ex.ko: 그는 늘 대장 노릇을 해서 친구들이 멀어졌다.

easy: The killing or hurting of people in fighting.

ex.en: The two sides made peace to stop the bloodshed.
ex.ko: 양쪽은 피 흘리는 일을 멈추려고 평화 협정을 맺었다.

easy: A pile of stones built to mark a trail or remember something.

ex.en: Hikers stacked rocks into a cairn to mark the trail.
ex.ko: 등산객들은 길을 표시하려고 돌을 쌓아 돌무더기를 만들었다.

easy: A dangerous illness of the stomach and gut that comes from dirty water or food.

ex.en: Clean drinking water helps stop cholera.
ex.ko: 깨끗한 식수는 콜레라를 막는 데 도움이 된다.

easy: To not go well together; to conflict.

ex.en: Our plans collided because soccer and the party were on the same day.
ex.ko: 축구와 파티가 같은 날이라 우리 계획이 서로 겹쳤다.

easy: Feeling you must do something again and again, even when you don't want to.

ex.en: He has a compulsive habit of checking the door lock three times.
ex.ko: 그는 문이 잠겼는지 세 번씩 확인하는 강박적인 습관이 있다.

easy: Present from birth.

ex.en: The puppy was born with a congenital heart problem.
ex.ko: 그 강아지는 선천적인 심장 질환을 가지고 태어났다.

easy: To understand something in a certain way.

ex.en: I construed her smile as a yes.
ex.ko: 나는 그녀의 미소를 좋다는 뜻으로 받아들였다.

easy: Having to do with a consul, an official who helps people from their country who are living in another country.

ex.en: We went to the consular office to get a visa.
ex.ko: 우리는 비자를 받으려고 영사관 사무실에 갔다.

easy: Run by many small groups instead of one central place.

ex.en: Our town has a decentralized school system where each school makes its own rules.
ex.ko: 우리 마을은 학교마다 스스로 규칙을 정하는 분권화된 학교 체제이다.

easy: A difference between two things that should be the same.

ex.en: There was a discrepancy between the two boys' stories.
ex.ko: 두 소년의 이야기가 서로 맞지 않았다.

easy: The US government department that enforces national laws.

ex.en: The Department of Justice makes sure national laws are followed.
ex.ko: 미국 법무부는 연방 법이 지켜지도록 한다.

easy: A folder with lots of information about one person or subject.

ex.en: The spy had a thick dossier about the villain.
ex.ko: 스파이는 악당에 대한 두꺼운 서류철을 가지고 있었다.

easy: A person who sells cloth and sewing supplies.

ex.en: The draper sold silk, wool, and buttons.
ex.ko: 포목상은 비단과 털실과 단추를 팔았다.

easy: A price that is much, much too high.

ex.en: Ten dollars for a bottle of water is extortion!
ex.ko: 물 한 병에 10달러라니 완전 바가지야!

easy: A way to use a computer by clicking on pictures, icons, and menus instead of typing commands.

ex.en: A GUI lets you open a game just by clicking its icon.
ex.ko: 그래픽 사용자 인터페이스 덕분에 아이콘만 누르면 게임을 열 수 있다.

easy: To take control of a vehicle, like a plane or ship, by force.

ex.en: In the movie, pirates hijacked a cargo ship.
ex.ko: 영화에서 해적들이 화물선을 납치했다.

easy: Taking control of a vehicle by force while it is traveling.

ex.en: The movie is about the hijack of a train.
ex.ko: 그 영화는 기차 납치 사건에 관한 이야기이다.

easy: A small flaw or mistake that keeps something from being perfect.

ex.en: Every handmade cup has a little imperfection.
ex.ko: 손으로 만든 컵에는 모두 작은 흠이 있다.

easy: A drink made by soaking leaves or herbs in hot water.

ex.en: Mom drinks an infusion of fresh mint leaves.
ex.ko: 엄마는 생 박하 잎을 우려낸 차를 드신다.

easy: Having to do with writing news for newspapers, TV, or websites.

ex.en: Our class newspaper taught us journalistic writing.
ex.ko: 학급 신문을 만들며 우리는 기사 쓰는 법을 배웠다.

easy: A unit scientists use to measure temperature, starting from the coldest possible point.

ex.en: Scientists measure very cold things in kelvins.
ex.ko: 과학자들은 아주 차가운 것의 온도를 켈빈으로 잰다.

easy: A person who does hard work with their hands.

ex.en: The laborers carried bricks to build the new school.
ex.ko: 인부들이 새 학교를 지으려고 벽돌을 날랐다.

easy: A fat or oil in living things.

ex.en: Butter and olive oil are both lipids.
ex.ko: 버터와 올리브유는 둘 다 지질이다.

easy: A title used when speaking to a British lord, judge, or bishop, as in "Your Lordship."

ex.en: "Yes, Your Lordship," said the servant with a bow.
ex.ko: "네, 나리." 하고 하인이 고개 숙여 말했다.

easy: A helper who obeys a boss without question, often in a silly or sneaky way.

ex.en: The villain sent his minions to steal the jewel.
ex.ko: 악당은 보석을 훔치려고 졸개들을 보냈다.

easy: A change in music from one key to another.

ex.en: The modulation moved the song to a higher key.
ex.ko: 전조로 노래가 더 높은 조로 바뀌었다.

easy: A person who drives a car.

ex.en: The sign warned motorists to slow down near the school.
ex.ko: 표지판은 운전자들에게 학교 근처에서 속도를 줄이라고 경고했다.

easy: Money you earn back from something you paid for.

ex.en: The payback from our solar panels will take about eight years.
ex.ko: 태양광 패널 비용을 다 돌려받으려면 8년쯤 걸린다.

easy: A book that shows a team's planned plays with drawings.

ex.en: The coach drew a new play in his playbook.
ex.ko: 코치는 작전집에 새 작전을 그려 넣었다.

easy: Something that makes the air, water, or soil dirty and harmful.

ex.en: Smoke from factories puts pollutants into the air.
ex.ko: 공장 연기는 공기 속에 오염 물질을 내보낸다.

easy: Turning to someone or something for help.

ex.en: When the teasing didn't stop, our only recourse was to tell a teacher.
ex.ko: 놀림이 멈추지 않자 우리가 할 수 있는 방법은 선생님께 말하는 것뿐이었다.

easy: A plan of medicine, food, or exercise to help someone get healthy.

ex.en: The doctor gave Grandpa a regimen of pills and daily walks.
ex.ko: 의사는 할아버지께 약과 매일 걷기로 된 치료 계획을 주셨다.

easy: Gathering farm animals together to count, mark, or sell them.

ex.en: The cowboys held a cattle roundup in the spring.
ex.ko: 카우보이들은 봄에 소몰이를 했다.

easy: To mean or show something.

ex.en: A red light signifies that you must stop.
ex.ko: 빨간불은 멈춰야 한다는 뜻이다.

easy: In a way that has to do with the spirit or the soul.

ex.en: Grandma feels spiritually calm when she prays.
ex.ko: 할머니는 기도하실 때 마음이 평온해지신다.

easy: The 19th letter of the Greek alphabet.

ex.en: Tau is the nineteenth letter of the Greek alphabet.
ex.ko: 타우는 그리스 문자의 열아홉 번째 글자이다.

easy: To tie up the wings and legs of a bird before cooking it.

ex.en: Mom trussed the turkey before putting it in the oven.
ex.ko: 엄마는 칠면조를 오븐에 넣기 전에 다리와 날개를 묶으셨다.

easy: A worker who belongs to a labor union.

ex.en: The unionists marched for better pay.
ex.ko: 노동조합원들이 더 나은 임금을 위해 행진했다.

easy: To make someone feel worried or nervous.

ex.en: The strange noise unsettled the dog.
ex.ko: 이상한 소리에 개가 불안해했다.

easy: To add notes that explain or comment on a piece of writing.

ex.en: We annotated the poem with notes in the margins.
ex.ko: 우리는 시의 여백에 메모를 적어 주석을 달았다.

easy: Having to do with an archive, a place where old records are kept.

ex.en: The museum showed archival photos of our town from 1900.
ex.ko: 박물관에는 1900년의 우리 마을 기록 사진이 전시되어 있었다.

easy: A plant that grows up walls, fences, or other plants.

ex.en: The climber covered the fence with purple flowers.
ex.ko: 덩굴 식물이 울타리를 보라색 꽃으로 뒤덮었다.

easy: A number that shows how much the prices of everyday things go up or down.

ex.en: The CPI shows how much the prices of things like milk and gas go up.
ex.ko: 소비자 물가 지수는 우유나 휘발유 같은 물건값이 얼마나 오르는지 보여 준다.

easy: To end with a big final event.

ex.en: The school year culminated in a big talent show.
ex.ko: 학년은 큰 장기 자랑으로 마무리되었다.

easy: In a way that tries to protect yourself from blame.

ex.en: "I was going to clean it later," he said defensively.
ex.ko: "나중에 치우려고 했어." 하고 그는 변명하듯 말했다.
